definitions.gloss: management fee; maintenance charge; administration fee
definitions.explanation: A fee charged for the management, maintenance, or administration of a property, facility, or service.

examples.japanese: {管理料|かんりりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{月額|げつがく}→月額：09739_getsugaku⟧{一万円|いちまんえん}だ。
examples.english: The management fee is 10,000 yen per month.

examples.japanese: ⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{管理料|かんりりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The apartment management fee was raised.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{管理料|かんりりょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{清掃費|せいそうひ}や⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{維持費|いじひ}→維持費：23066_ijihi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: The parking lot management fee includes cleaning costs and equipment maintenance expenses.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧ (management, administration) and ⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧ (fee, charge). Commonly encountered in housing, real estate, and facility usage. In apartment living, {管理料|かんりりょう} or ⟦{管理費|かんりひ}→管理費：06575_kanrihi⟧ covers shared costs like elevator maintenance, cleaning of common areas, and building security.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {管理料|かんりりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay a management fee
- {管理料|かんりりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧: management fee increase
- ⟦{月額|げつがく}→月額：09739_getsugaku⟧{管理料|かんりりょう}: monthly management fee
- {管理料|かんりりょう}⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧: management fee included

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{管理費|かんりひ}→管理費：06575_kanrihi⟧: management expenses — nearly synonymous; ⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ emphasizes cost/expense while ⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧ emphasizes a set fee
- ⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧: handling fee, commission — a fee for processing or service
- ⟦{維持費|いじひ}→維持費：23066_ijihi⟧: maintenance costs — focuses specifically on keeping something in working condition
